Tabbed sections visible include: MISC, LIFE PHILOSOPHY, FIGHTING LIFE, HUMOROUS, LOVE, LOVE LOST, LOST INNOSCENCE [sic], BIG GIANT ANTS, DEATH & SUFFERING, GOD IS DEAD, POLITICS / FUCK BUSH, NOT SOBER, LEARNING. Sample poems transcribed: MORAL MESSAGES section - "ODE TO JASON (A FALLEN HERO)": 'This is a story about a boy whose dog ran away / Who, during a snowstorm, went out to play / Jason set out to find a loved one - no matter what the cost / But as the dog came home the little boy became lost / When you're a fourth grader finding a dog is no easy task / Should you risk your life for a pet? It depends on whom you ask / The fact that Jason said yes should come as no surprise / He loved that dog to pieces so he set out through the snow / Little Jason was a hero so he set out through the snow / So it saddens my heart deeply to tell his tale of woe / What a brave little soul, right up until the end / What a bit of inspiration is what he left behind / He listened to his heart, paid no attention to his mind / And right before he left our world with the situation oh so grim / The last thought that filled his head - his dog would do the same for him / The saddest of it all and the reason why we cried / If not for the heart of an angel he never would have died / When you think of him in memory try to wipe away your tears / And remember him for what he was which is wise beyond his years'; "FOLLOWING THE BLIND": 'Such a waste of time... Following the blind... Open up your eyes... Haven't you realized? / 'Tis better to lead them... And still be breathing... Than it is to follow...
